births.citation: NCHS Data Brief No. 535, Births in the United States, 2024 (https://www.cdc.gov/nchs/products/databriefs/db535.htm): births per 1,000 women by age of mother, 2024.

deathsCitation: SSA Office of the Chief Actuary, Actuarial Study No. 120, Table 7 cohort life tables (src/core2/data/ssa-cohort-life-tables.json): qx by age, sex and birth decade, taken monthly as qx / 12.

moves.citation: American Community Survey 2024 one-year, table B07401 (leaving the county by age, each state; national rates for territories the survey doesn't cover) and arrivals per resident from another county, state or abroad (data/research/migration/mover-rates-acs-2024.json). Holds on leaving from the moves engine's parameters (CPS ASEC 2023 tenure; school-age children).

stateMortality.citation: NCHS, Leading Causes of Death: United States (data.cdc.gov dataset bi63-dtpu), all causes, age-adjusted death rate per 100,000, 2017, the latest final year it carries: United States 731.9. Each state's ratio to the national rate scales the SSA cohort life table for people there. Read Oct. 13, 2026.
stateMortality.territories: Puerto Rico, Guam, the U.S. Virgin Islands, American Samoa and the Northern Mariana Islands are not in the dataset and take the national rate (ratio 1), an estimate from the average.
